pause: Run module command pause with --stage. The active run checkpoints and exits; queued continuation is cancelled.
resume: Run module command resume with --stage. Full optimizer, RNG and sampling state resumes.
modifications: Pause before changing requested scope. Keep a submitted protocol frozen; create a new version for changed losses, calibration or schedules.
continuation: 24-hour allocations, stop signal before limit, one dependent successor; completed runs are skipped.
other_jobs: Do not submit other-model bands, cross-dataset exploration or full sweep automatically.
long_sweep_archive_requirement: Before unattended long-sweep submission, remove the laptop-dependent archive acknowledgment bottleneck using an approved, always-available durable archive outside BeeGFS. Current remote home is BeeGFS; /tmp is not a durable project archive.
